name: research-lab — AI 研究實驗室
description: Break complex research, investigation, market analysis, product analysis, competitor analysis, technical trend research, business model analysis, growth strategy, SEO/GEO, education, AI, or tutoring topics into verifiable breadth scans, depth dives, cross-validation, and decision-ready reports.

research_topic.description: Research topic, keyword, market, product, strategy, technology, or decision question.

mode.description: full, breadth_only, depth_only, or quick. Defaults to full when not specified.

decision_context.description: Decision use case, constraints, time range, geography, industry scope, and required depth.

source_materials.description: Optional documents, links, notes, competitor names, data, or prior research.

rules: Tie each subtask back to the original research topic.
Mark uncertainty and confidence for risky conclusions.
Do not invent sources, evidence, or statistics.
